anomalies.observed: In the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' block on the root sheet, the 22 nF capacitor C17 (to GND), the 1 kΩ series resistor R6 (to the A1/TSC electrode BTN pin), and BOTH the NET0011 and NET0012 labels are tied onto one continuous node. NET0011 (PB5) and NET0012 (PB7) are therefore merged, and the sampling capacitor sits on the same net as the electrode series resistor.
anomalies.expected: Per the specification the two TSC pins must be separate: 'TSC_G2_IO2: U2 pin 57 (PB5) — R8 (1 kΩ series resistor) — A2 pin BTN' and 'TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND)'. PB5 carries only the series resistor to the electrode; PB7 carries only the sampling capacitor to GND; the two nets must not be joined.

anomalies.impact: The STM32 Touch Sensing Controller group-2 sampling capacitor is shorted onto the sense-electrode line and the two TSC GPIOs (PB5, PB7) are merged, so the capacitive touch button will not sense correctly (or at all).
